div.span: Step 1: Input Preprocessing

Final Binary Mask
(512×512, dtype=bool)

Compare vs Ground Truth
TP = pred ∩ gt
FP = pred - gt
FN = gt - pred

Volumetric IoU
= ΣTP / (ΣTP + ΣFP + ΣFN)
across ALL validation slices
Final Result: 83.92% IoU

Bilinear Upsample
28×28 → 512×512
via inverse_grid mapping
using crop box coordinates

Optimized Guided Filter (size=25)
────────────────────
μ_I = uniform_filter(CT, 25)
μ_p = uniform_filter(prob, 25)
σ² = uniform_filter(CT², 25) - μ_I²
cov = uniform_filter(CT×prob, 25) - μ_I×μ_p
a = cov / (σ² + ε), ε = 0.01
b = μ_p - a×μ_I
output = mean(a)×CT + mean(b)
────────────────────
⚠️ size=25 is critical rescue:
must be large enough to smooth
the sharp STEGO predictions

Aggressive Binarization
mask = (filtered ≥ 0.30)
⚠️ Low threshold compensates for
the Guided Filter dampening
the overconfident probabilities

Largest Connected Component
scipy.ndimage.label → keep biggest blob
Removes floating false-positive islands

Hole Filling
ndi.binary_fill_holes()
Patches any internal gaps

Morphological Closing
Binary closing with disk(radius=3)
structure = x²+y² ≤ 9
Smooths jagged outer contour

For each val patch (70-dim):
Compute L2 distance to all 8 centers

Temperature Scaling
temp = median(d₂ - d₁) / ln(4)
where d₁, d₂ are nearest two distances

Softmax Probabilities
w_k = exp(-(d_k - d_min) / temp)
p_k = w_k / Σw_k

Extract liver channel
field = p_liver reshaped to 28×28
⚠️ Values are near-binary (0.99/0.01)
due to STEGO overconfidence

For each of 8 clusters, compute:
• Normalized X centroid (0=left, 1=right)
• Normalized Y centroid (0=top, 1=bottom)
• Mean HU of member patches

Filter 1: centroid_x < 0.5
(must be on RIGHT side of body)

Filter 2: centroid_y < 0.6
(must be in UPPER abdomen)

Filter 3: 40 ≤ Mean HU ≤ 180
(must be solid organ density)

Select cluster with
LARGEST AREA among survivors
→ This is the Liver Cluster

Flatten all TRAIN patches
N_train × 784 × 70 → (N×784, 70)

sklearn KMeans(n_clusters=8)
seed=0, n_init=3
max_iter=100, algorithm=lloyd

8 Cluster Centers
Each center: 70-dim vector

Load final.pt checkpoint
(seed 0, 5000 training steps)

cluster2: Conv2d(768→768,1×1)
→ ReLU
→ Conv2d(768→70,1×1)

Output: 28×28 × 70 embeddings
⚠️ These are OVERCONFIDENT
due to contrastive training

Frozen BiomedCLIP ViT-B/16
(NO gradients, eval mode)

Output: 14×14 × 768 features
Bilinearly upsampled to 28×28 × 768

HU Conversion
HU = pixel × Slope + Intercept
Raw DICOM (512×512)

Body Crop
threshold HU > -500
binary_opening(disk r=5)
largest connected component
binary_fill_holes
→ bounding box [y0, x0, side]

Resize to 224×224
bilinear interpolation
3-channel + Normalize
